AgentRunEstimateOut.description:
What a start would cost, before anything is created. `cost_usd` is null for a model
without catalog prices; `over_limit` says a start needs force.
AgentRunEstimateOut.title: AgentRunEstimateOut

ApproveRunIn.description: `all` saves every proposed item; otherwise only the listed indexes, with any edits.
ApproveRunIn.title: ApproveRunIn

ConversationPatch.description: Rename, or turn project code context on or off. Only the fields sent change.
ConversationPatch.title: ConversationPatch

CredentialTestIn.description:
Empty on purpose. A JSON body makes clients (and /docs) send
`Content-Type: application/json`, which every write request must have (rule 29).
CredentialTestIn.title: CredentialTestIn

MemoryItemCreate.description: For a decision, `body` is what was decided.
MemoryItemCreate.title: MemoryItemCreate

MemoryItemPatch.description: Only the fields that are sent change. Sending none is an error.
MemoryItemPatch.title: MemoryItemPatch

MemoryItemStatus.description: All statuses in one column. Which ones a kind may use is in `STATUSES_BY_KIND`.
MemoryItemStatus.title: MemoryItemStatus

ProjectPatch.description: Only the fields sent change. `default_model_id: null` clears the default model.
ProjectPatch.title: ProjectPatch

SupersedeIn.description: Replace a decision: either with a new one (`decision`) or with an existing one (`by_id`).
SupersedeIn.title: SupersedeIn

UsageRecordOut.description: One model call. Metadata only: never prompts, replies or keys.
UsageRecordOut.title: UsageRecordOut

app__modules__workflow__schemas__EmptyIn.description: Write endpoints take a JSON body even when there is nothing to send (`{}`).
app__modules__workflow__schemas__EmptyIn.title: EmptyIn

post.description:
Save all or the chosen proposed items (with edits) to project memory, in one
transaction. Tasks become todo, decisions proposed.
Queued: cancelled now. Running: stops before its next step.
Close the run with a reason. Nothing is saved.

patch.description: Rename, or turn project code context on or off for this conversation.

get.description:
Exactly what would be sent to `model_id`: every section, its tokens, the budget, the
total and what is dropped. No LLM call, no keys.

post.description: Send a message; the reply streams as SSE: message_start, delta..., message_end | error.
Make the smallest possible call with this key. Send `{}` as the body.
A queued run stops now; a running one stops before its next batch.

patch.description: Changes only the fields that are sent; last write wins.

post.description: The task depends on `depends_on_id`. Adding a link that exists changes nothing.
Replace a decision with a new one ({"decision": {...}}) or an existing one ({"by_id"}).

get.description: All projects with their index status.

post.description: Create a project, optionally with its source folder.

delete.description: Delete the project and all its data. 409 while an index run is queued or running.

get.description: One project with its index status.

patch.description:
Rename the project or set its default chat model. An unknown or disabled model is 422
`model_unavailable`; a model without a saved key is allowed (the UI warns).

get.description: Plan and review runs, newest first.

post.description:
Start a plan (Planner, then Reviewer) or review (Reviewer only) run in the background.
The response carries the estimate; poll GET /agent-runs/{id}. 409 when a run is active or
the estimate is over the cost limit without force; 413 when the prompt doesn't fit.

The estimate a start with this body would get, so the user can confirm first. Makes the
same checks as a start (404, 413, 422) but no run, no model call; `force` is ignored.

get.description: Indexed and skipped files, with the reason a file was skipped.
Past gap finder results, newest first.

post.description:
Find gaps for the current stage now (one model call, purpose agent_run). A failed run
is saved, then its error is returned.

Start (re-)indexing in the background. 409 if a run is active or the estimate is over
the cost limit without force; 422 without a folder, embedding model or key.
What indexing would do and cost now. Reads the folder; no model call.

get.description:
A page of memory items, ordered by created_at then id. `limit` is capped by
MEMORY_PAGE_MAX (default 100).

The project memory that would be pinned for `model_id` now: the exact text, its tokens,
and the ids left out with the reason (kind_cap or budget). No LLM call.

Served here, not by the projects module, because it needs the model's token counter.

post.description:
Dev-only: test retrieval. Embeds the query (purpose "embedding") and returns the
merged results with their vector rank, text rank and fused score. 404 unless
APP_ENV=development.

put.description: Set or change the folder to index. A new folder needs an explicit re-index.

get.description:
Stage, checklist, gate status and events. A project without a stored workflow shows the
first stage; nothing is written until the first change.

post.description:
Approve the current stage. 409 stage_gate_unmet lists what is missing, unless
force=true with a reason.
Back to the first stage. Also the way out when the stored stage no longer exists.

get.description: Totals grouped by purpose and trigger, so each background purpose is its own line.

Single calls, newest first (for the activity log): model, purpose, trigger, tokens, cost,
status. Never prompts or replies.

API status, `database` up or down, and `keys`: none, ok, unreadable (the master key
can't decrypt a saved provider key) or unknown. Answers within about 2 s; never raises.
